title: How does Pinnacle Blooms use Occupational Therapy in conjunction with ABA Therapy for treating Autism?
metaTitle: Blending Occupational Therapy and ABA Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn more about how Pinnacle Blooms Network uses a combined approach of Occupational Therapy and ABA Therapy for comprehensive treatment of Autism.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe in the holistic approach for treating Autism. We combine Occupational Therapy with ABA Therapy to help the child master everyday tasks independently while embedding their learned skills. This integrated approach allows us to address the child's overall development effectively.
